TestSigma is accelerating software delivery with its low-code, NLP-powered test automation platform. Its platform automates SaaS discovery, spend optimization, and license management, giving IT teams control and visibility across sprawling software stacks. NyraHealth is advancing neuro rehabilitation with its AI-powered digital therapy platform. Tailored for disorders affecting speech, language, and cognition, NyraHealth combines diagnostic tools with interactive therapy exercises. The platform supports patients in recovery while equipping clinicians with data-driven insights to personalize treatment pathways.

Xund is creating the infrastructure for digital-first healthcare through its AI-powered medical API. Designed for patients, providers, and insurers, the platform delivers evidence-based symptom checks, triage, and treatment guidance. With scalable integrations, Xund makes reliable medical insights accessible across multiple touchpoints in the healthcare journey.

ConfigHub is a new SaaS product for application teams operating in conditions of live production. Quaisr’s platform offers digital connectivity infrastructure that scales simulation-backed AI workflows to mission-critical operational deployments, helping engineers to solve pressing problems in design, monitoring, optimisation and control.

Qapita is simplifying equity management for private companies and investors across Asia. Its platform digitizes cap tables, employee stock ownership plans, and transaction workflows, ensuring accuracy and compliance. By centralizing equity data, Qapita helps founders, employees, and shareholders collaborate seamlessly on ownership and liquidity events.

Milieu Insight is delivering agile consumer data and analytics to power market research and customer understanding. Through mobile-first surveys and real-time dashboards, Milieu enables businesses to capture and analyze consumer sentiment at scale. Tinybird is the way to build real-time data products. They help data teams deliver real-time answers at scale through analytical API endpoints built in minutes, not weeks.

Harbr provides private data ecosystem platforms that enable organisations to exchange, monetise and collaborate on data and models with their customers, suppliers and partners. Harbr is used by data-driven enterprises and some of the world's largest data businesses.
OpenSensors provides the next generation smart Building Management System. Their sensors and analytics tools help you make the most effective use of your space and reduce lease expenses.

DePoly is tackling plastic waste with its breakthrough PET recycling technology. By converting post-consumer and industrial PET into raw materials, DePoly enables true circularity in plastics. Its low-energy, scalable process helps manufacturers reduce reliance on virgin inputs while supporting global sustainability goals.

H2Site is unlocking hydrogen’s potential with innovative transport and integration technologies. Using its proprietary palladium-silver alloy membranes, H2Site enables efficient hydrogen separation and distribution with a low carbon footprint. Its solutions support the scaling of clean hydrogen as a cornerstone of the energy transition.

PQShield provides quantum-secure cryptographic solutions for software, software/hardware co-design and data in transit, especially focused on connected systems across telecoms, automotive, smart environments and financial institutions.
Gigs is the world’s first telecom-as-a-service platform. They offer an API and white-label product that allows businesses and brands to offer fully-fledged phone plans on any network globally.

Scrut is enabling mid-market companies to simplify governance, risk, and compliance with its end-to-end GRC platform. From monitoring infosec risks to automating audits, Scrut consolidates processes into a single dashboard. The solution reduces compliance complexity and empowers businesses to scale securely while meeting evolving regulatory requirements.

Privyr equips sales professionals with a mobile-first workflow platform that automates lead management, CRM, and content sharing. By simplifying follow-ups and streamlining customer communications, Privyr enables users to close deals faster. Its intuitive design makes enterprise-grade tools accessible to individuals and small teams, directly from their smartphones.

Enterprise software for improving the efficiency, collaboration and security of the pharmaceutical supply chain. Silverflow offers a cloud-native card processing platform. It enables payment providers to better serve their merchants by directly accessing card networks, instantly adding new functionality and getting smart data direct from the networks.

Edufund is tackling the challenge of education affordability by offering savings, investments, and loans tailored for families. Its fintech platform helps parents plan and finance their children’s education from school to university. By combining financial products with personalized advice, Edufund supports long-term academic aspirations with accessible funding solutions.

IMMIX is powering institutional crypto trading with infrastructure built for speed and precision. Offering ultra-low latency connections to leading exchanges, IMMIX enables quantitative and systematic funds to execute strategies seamlessly. Its platform also provides algorithm development, monitoring, and reporting modules, giving funds the tools to trade digital assets with confidence.

Tuio is modernizing insurance with a mobile-first, transparent neo-insurer model. Focused on home, life, and pet insurance, Tuio offers flexible, customer-friendly policies delivered entirely online. With a commitment to simplicity and fairness, Tuio is setting a new standard for digital-native insurance experiences.

Fence delivers end-to-end debt management software purpose-built for structured credit. By digitizing workflows for asset-backed financing, Fence enhances transparency, compliance, and operational efficiency. Its platform empowers financial institutions to manage complex portfolios with greater accuracy and agility.

Qoala is reshaping insurance distribution in Southeast Asia with its omnichannel platform. Operating in Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia, Qoala provides products spanning travel, health, property, and more. Its digital-first model makes insurance simpler, more transparent, and more widely accessible, driving financial inclusion across the region.

InDebted is reimagining debt collection through a digital-first, customer-centric model. By combining data intelligence with omni-channel communications, InDebted provides a respectful and accessible experience for consumers while improving recovery rates for financial institutions and corporates. Its technology-driven approach sets a new standard for fairness and transparency in collections.

Griffin is a fully regulated neobank offering a complete Banking-as-a-Service platform. As both PRA-authorized and FCA-licensed, Griffin provides fintechs and financial institutions with a secure, compliant foundation to build and scale. Its full-stack infrastructure allows customers to integrate banking products seamlessly while reducing the complexity of regulatory requirements.

BondBloX is building the infrastructure for digital bond trading through its electronic exchange and information services platform. By fractionalizing bonds and enabling real-time settlement, BondBloX broadens market access for investors while improving liquidity and transparency. Its approach modernizes a traditionally opaque and fragmented asset class.

Accelex is empowering institutional investors with automated data extraction, reporting, and analytics for alternative investments. By digitizing workflows and unlocking insights from complex private markets data, Accelex helps Limited Partners make more informed decisions. The platform reduces manual effort, accelerates reporting cycles, and delivers greater transparency across portfolios.

Aspire is redefining SME banking with its all-in-one financial operating system. By unifying accounts, payments, expense management, and credit into a single platform, Aspire simplifies financial operations for growing businesses. Its digital-first approach enables faster decision-making, improved cash flow visibility, and seamless integration with modern business tools.

Paid is a next-generation procurement automation platform that transforms the procure-to-pay process to make it easier and faster for everyone. They deliver cost savings for buyers and faster payments for suppliers.
Centrifuge is a protocol for decentralised asset finance. Borrowers can access "bank-less" liquidity and investors can earn attractive yields from an open marketplace of asset pools.

Bioraptor's AI powered platform allows bio manufacturing companies to extract actionable insights from their bioprocess data sources. Bioraptor makes it easier, quicker and more cost-effective for scientists to discover, develop and scale processes, to scale the process of developing and producing food and pharma products.

HelloBetter is delivering clinically validated digital therapeutics for mental health. With evidence-based programs designed by psychologists and medical professionals, HelloBetter helps individuals manage conditions like depression, anxiety, and stress. Its scalable platform integrates seamlessly into healthcare systems, giving patients timely support while reducing pressure on traditional care pathways.

Daye is redefining women’s health with a comprehensive gynae platform that provides personalized pain relief, diagnostics, and access to innovative treatments. From chronic pelvic pain to sexual health, Daye connects users to trusted specialists including nurses, dermatologists, and gynecological experts. With a focus on personalization and accessibility, Daye is breaking down barriers to care in traditionally underserved areas of women’s health.

Oncoshot is transforming clinical research by enabling a federated approach to data analysis for trial insights. Through secure partnerships with hospitals and research institutions, Oncoshot empowers stakeholders to access and analyze oncology data without compromising patient privacy. This accelerates trial matching, improves recruitment efficiency, and helps researchers unlock deeper insights to advance cancer care.

Cyberhaven is a Data Behaviour Analytics solution that provides visibility into the movement of data and intellectual property as it travels across cloud and on-premises environments, to reveal intent of data exfiltration and expose insider threats.

HarfangLab develops next-generation endpoint detection and response (EDR) software for businesses and the public sector. Its platform equips organizations to detect, investigate, and neutralize cyber threats quickly and effectively. Designed with scalability and compliance in mind, HarfangLab delivers robust protection for critical infrastructure and sensitive data.

Microsec provides end-to-end cybersecurity for the Internet of Things, securing devices at the edge. Its solutions detect, protect, and mitigate threats directly at the device level, adaptable to both greenfield deployments and legacy brownfield systems. By embedding security into IoT ecosystems, Microsec ensures resilience across connected infrastructure.

CloudSek is redefining threat intelligence with its no-code platform that uses AI to deliver predictive cybersecurity analytics. By identifying risks before they escalate, CloudSek enables organizations to protect critical assets proactively. Its approach combines scalability and simplicity, making advanced cyber defense accessible across industries.

Icite is challenging the traditional identity threat detection & response approach by putting real-time intelligence, investigation, and isolation capabilities at the core of the user experience. With Icite, organizations can accelerate identity security through cross team collaboration, powerful threat investigation features and self service audit capabilities at their fingertips.
